title: DiagramCard
description: Provenance record for one rendered diagram (Mermaid, D2, Cytoscape, semantic-HTML wireframe, or other provider): what engine and version produced it, its source, its security profile, and its accessibility description. See lib/diagram-card.mjs.

id.description: Stable identity, used as the graph node key (contract:<id>)

source.description: Diagram-definition text (e.g. mermaid/d2 syntax) or a path to it

engine.description: unknown means no renderer could be resolved at build time

engineVersion.description: Resolved via the engine's own --version at render time; null when source-only or unresolved

theme.description: Theme id/name used, null when not applicable

seed.description: Deterministic seed for hand-drawn/random layout modes; null when the engine has none

securityProfile.description: e.g. sandboxed-subprocess (D2/dot), browser-innerHTML-loose (current Mermaid web path); never omitted

command.description: Plain-text description of the invocation, never markdown/HTML

degraded.description: true when any required field could not be genuinely resolved

reason.description: Non-empty when degraded is true, null otherwise
